philosophyQuotes.title: Time is priceless
details: Time is priceless. You can’t buy it, pause it, or rewind it. Once it’s gone, it’s gone for good.
We spend so much of our lives chasing things—money, status, validation—but time is the one thing we can never earn back.
So be mindful of how you use it. Invest it in what truly matters: the people you love, the goals that inspire you, the moments that feed your soul.
